description: This Java class 'EmailConfig' defines configuration settings for email services, including SMTP server details, security options, and email template paths. It implements JSON serialization to produce a JSON representation of its configuration.

classes.name: EmailConfig
classes.description: A class representing email configuration settings such as SMTP host, port, protocol, credentials, and security options. Implements JSON serialization for configuration data.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the email configuration to a JSON string.

methods.name: isSmtpAuth
methods.description: Returns whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setSmtpAuth
methods.description: Sets whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Sets the path for email templates.
